title: Aries: Any%, No Resets
old_caption: Eye contact in under a second, first text in two, and then the one split no strategy can skip: waiting for the reply. Who else sprints straight into the wait?

title: Taurus: Slow Burn%
old_caption: Month four of saying nothing, one table closer at a time. Then one tiny "hi", and it turns out they'd been waiting since month one. Slow runs still finish.

title: Gemini: The Ramble Skip
old_caption: The awkward silence on a first date? Skipped. Talked through it about soup, maps and a cousin's dog. Then the date started rambling back. Who's the nervous talker in your group?

title: Cancer: Soft-Locked on "k"
old_caption: One letter, read forty-seven times, a full spiral about whether they're mad. They were driving. Tell us you've been stuck on a "k" too.

title: Leo: The Spotlight Skip
old_caption: Three skip attempts: the entrance, the ta-da, the spin. None of them worked. One question and actually listening did. Which sign needs this strat tip most?

title: Virgo: Reset Number Forty
old_caption: Forty resets on the word "hey". The forty-first went out with a typo, and the reply copied it back. Who else drafts a two-letter text like it's a speech?

title: Libra: Stuck on the Menu Screen
old_caption: Four options, eighteen minutes, one dizzy Libra. Then the date just said "the pier?" and the run was back on. Tag the friend who can never pick the restaurant.

title: Scorpio: Playing It Cool
old_caption: Checked the phone, said "cool.", faked a yawn, left first. Every cool move cost time. One honest sentence won it all back. Who in your life plays it way too cool?

title: Sagittarius: Side Quest
old_caption: Pet the dog, helped with a map, went for dumplings. Main quest abandoned. Then the last dumpling had someone else's name on it too. Best wrong turn you ever took?

title: Capricorn: Love, Scheduled
old_caption: Calendar full until next quarter, so love got pencilled in for later. Then one optional meeting got dragged off the week and Saturday opened up. Who needs to see this?
